response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean FROM t

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 give no rate (NULLIF makes the division NULL), so they are ignored in the averages. Events with no valid rate yield a NULL event rate, which is ignored in the type average.
The simple mean of the per-type averages is the unweighted mean across types. A type whose average is NULL is excluded from that mean.
